name: Sallya
source:
"Sadness and suffering are now things of the past. Now, won't you drown in wonderful love within me? "

One of the enigmatic Night Demons to appear in Ouma City is a woman of sultry allure and sensual presence. Known among Japanese exorcists as "Enki," the "Seductive Ogre," she embodies an uncanny blend of voluptuousness and mystique.

Sallya carries a tranquil presence but isn't shy about taking the initiative. She radiates a profound empathy and compassion even towards those who bear her ill will, displaying an uncharacteristic depth of understanding.

At first glance, she may appear harmless, but her words wield a power that directly interferes with the minds of others. Those who engage her in conversation soon find themselves ensnared, viewing Sallya as a mother figure or a lover. Eventually, these unfortunate souls succumb to their carnal desires, only to have their vital energies sapped away, leaving them but empty husks.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/sen_nagi/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
